# Getting help

Start with the [curriculum](../breakdown/CURRICULUM.md) and the
[documentation map](../README.md#how-to-read-the-repository).

Use this repository's issue templates for a learning-document problem or a
bounded orchestration exercise proposal.

This repository does not provide OpenRig installation, runtime, migration, or
troubleshooting support. Historical commands and source are evidence for study,
not supported operations.
